title: Monkey in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Scarf tails (behind head) -->
  <path d='M52,68 Q64,74 70,86 Q72,90 68,91 Q64,92 62,88 Q58,78 50,72 Z' fill='#e8453c'/>
  <path d='M52,68 Q66,72 74,82 Q77,86 73,88 Q69,89 67,85 Q62,76 50,71 Z' fill='#ff6b5e'/>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='17' ry='15' fill='#8a5a3c'/>
  <!-- Belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='10' ry='11' fill='#d9a870'/>
  <!-- Arms -->
  <ellipse cx='31' cy='74' rx='6' ry='9' fill='#8a5a3c' transform='rotate(20 31 74)'/>
  <ellipse cx='69' cy='74' rx='6' ry='9' fill='#8a5a3c' transform='rotate(-20 69 74)'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='42' r='8' fill='#8a5a3c'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='42' r='8' fill='#8a5a3c'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='42' r='4.5' fill='#e8b98a'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='42' r='4.5' fill='#e8b98a'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='21' ry='19' fill='#8a5a3c'/>
  <!-- Face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='15' ry='12' fill='#e8b98a'/>
  <!-- Brows -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='40' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#a8704a'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='40' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#a8704a'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='47' r='4' fill='#fff6e0'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='47' r='4' fill='#fff6e0'/>
  <circle cx='42.5' cy='47.5' r='2.2' fill='#3a2418'/>
  <circle cx='58.5' cy='47.5' r='2.2' fill='#3a2418'/>
  <!-- Nose/muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#f5cfa0'/>
  <ellipse cx='47' cy='54' rx='1.4' ry='1.8' fill='#6b4530'/>
  <ellipse cx='53' cy='54' rx='1.4' ry='1.8' fill='#6b4530'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M44,58 Q50,63 56,58' fill='none' stroke='#6b4530' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Scarf wrapped around neck -->
  <path d='M35,65 Q50,72 65,65 Q66,70 50,76 Q34,70 35,65 Z' fill='#ff6b5e'/>
  <path d='M35,65 Q50,72 65,65' fill='none' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
